sources.title: EmbeddingGemma — Google DeepMind
sources.snippet: EmbeddingGemma generates high-quality embeddings with reduced resource consumption, enabling on-device Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, semantic search, and generative AI applications that can run on everyday devices.

sources.title: EmbeddingGemma | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: EmbeddingGemma 2 is a lightweight, open-source 740M parameter model designed for unified multimodal embeddings. Built on the Gemma 4 decoder architecture, it maps text, images, audio, and video into a unified 768-dimensional vector space.
